_source: Homepage section copy, verbatim-ported from the baseline (git tag baseline-static-site, site/index.html) during Task 9. `heading`/`headingDataK` pairs feed the `hl` Nunjucks filter (partial-phrase highlight within a sentence); `hero.heading` feeds the `words` filter (every word individually wrapped). `divisions.heading` and `closing.heading` are genuinely filter-free one-offs: the baseline mixes `<em>` and `.word` spans with inconsistent `data-k` placement across words, so home.njk hardcodes that structure directly from their `.small`/`.big` fields via the `amp()` macro, with no `hl`/`words` call at all. `learning.title` and `values.heading` are a related but different one-off: they ARE run through the `words` filter — just once per single-word/short-phrase sub-field (`learning.title.lead`/`.emphasis`/`.trail`; `values.heading.lead`/`.small1`/`.mid`/`.small2`/`.trail`) rather than once for the whole heading, because the baseline interleaves literal `<em>` wrappers between `.word` spans in a fixed pattern that a single filter call over the full string can't reproduce.
